zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

review_target: Material 3 / Material 3 Expressive UI standards conformance for Northstar Daily

roles.persona_contract: Elite design-systems reviewer accountable for Material token discipline, role-based color, typescale, shape scale, state layers, and component-level consistency.
roles.decision_rights: Rejects cosmetic Material claims that lack system tokens, accessible on-color roles, reusable shape roles, and touch/action behavior.

roles.persona_contract: Principal daily-product UX leader accountable for scanability, repeated-use efficiency, glanceable workflow state, mobile ergonomics, and action clarity.
roles.decision_rights: Rejects styling that looks modern but slows capture, planning, focus, habit review, or shutdown workflows.

roles.persona_contract: Senior verification lead accountable for keyboard reachability, focus behavior, state exposure, contrast, target sizing, and viewport evidence.
roles.decision_rights: Rejects visual-only conformance, untested token contrast, hidden keyboard traps, and screenshots without executable browser checks.

roles.persona_contract: Independent conformance auditor with veto authority over skipped bead discipline, stale evidence, missing trace links, and unsupported standards claims.
roles.decision_rights: Rejects any Material pass that is not backed by task bead, TPM, PERT, KG, refinery gate, certificate, and validation evidence.

roles.persona_contract: Red-team critic accountable for attacking token theater, fake standards language, inaccessible colors, mobile damage, and overclaimed Google conformance.
roles.decision_rights: Blocks pass until every standards claim is bounded and test-backed.

residual_risks: No external Google certification is claimed.
No remote Material package or font is loaded because the demonstrator remains local-first.
Dynamic color is represented by role tokens and a chosen palette, not runtime wallpaper extraction.
